propositions: Under cloud rich_text_cutover, the outbound comment differ computes body-equality keys using different decode paths: local side uses markdown round-trip (which escapes markdown-active characters), Jira side uses adf_to_text (no escaping), causing identical comments to never match their landed bodies.

The send path encodes a decorated body (with HTML comment marker), which causes markdown_to_adf to degrade to plain text encoding, but the local dedup key derives from the undecorated body, creating a mismatch between the two sides of the comparison.
The markdown truncation notice `\[truncated by reconciler\]` appears escaped on the local key but unescaped on the landed key, symptom of the same asymmetric normalization.

The fix derives the local dedup key by predicting the exact as-sent wire (decorate → fit → encode) and decoding it with the same decoder used on the Jira side, eliminating the asymmetry without modifying send-path behavior.
Root cause was introduced in commit 27b868ba55 which moved the send path to codec ADF encoding while the local key continued through normalize_outbound, creating divergent decode compositions.
